content:
Today is September 1st, and Apple officially handed over the CEO role from Tim Cook to John Ternus, marking the official start of a new era under Ternus's leadership.

From the company's freshly updated leadership page, the change can be seen: Ternus has been given the CEO title, while Cook has moved to the board section, taking on the newly established role of Executive Chairman.

外界預期Ternus接掌帥印將預示公司策略出現轉向，相較於Cook擅長嘅營運管理，Ternus會帶來更以產品為本嘅願景。不過呢啲改變需要時間逐步落地。佢首個公開亮相嘅任務，將係喺9月9日舉行嘅秋季發佈會上，介紹全新iPhone 18 Pro及iPhone Ultra系列產品線。

Previously, the leadership website's board members section only listed names. With Cook joining the board's ranks, Apple has also expanded this section by adding individual photos of each member.

Board members include Tim Cook, Arthur Levinson, Wanda Austin, Alex Gorsky, Andrea Jung, Monica Lozano, Ron Sugar, Sue Wagner, and John Ternus (who occupies a board seat in his capacity as CEO).
